title: Location Filter
description: Location constraints and preferences for location-aware catalog and store-finder requests. Catalog filters are advisory unless explicitly documented as constraints by the operation.

location_ids.description: Business-defined location identifiers to constrain or prioritize the response.

preferred_location_id.description: Business-defined location identifier to prefer when ranking results. This is a ranking hint, not a required selection.

geo.description: Buyer-granted location coordinates for proximity filtering or ranking.

postal_code.description: Postal code used for proximity filtering or ranking when precise coordinates are unavailable.

radius.description: Maximum distance from geo or postal_code.

method_types.description: Fulfillment method types the caller is interested in. PRs that add protocol-blessed method types extend this enum.

limit.description: Requested maximum number of locations or destinations to return.
